post.title: Why job posts show pay: 1 in 5 in 2020, 51.1% by Aug 2026
post.ig:
In 2020, only about 1 in 5 US job posts showed pay.

By August 2026, 51.1% of US postings on Indeed listed pay (Indeed Hiring Lab, 3-month average).
Colorado required pay in postings from January 2021, NYC from November 2022, California and Washington from January 2023, five more states in 2025, and Virginia and Maine in July 2026.
The EU set a June 7, 2026 deadline for pay info before the interview; only 4 of 27 countries met it.

Sources: Indeed Hiring Lab pay-transparency data (Aug 2026), state labor laws, Axios (June 2021), Mayer Brown (July 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
Follow @financeprostv for money explained simply.
